```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library("sapid")
```

This article demonstrates the sensory harmonization, psychophysical threshold
modeling, paired modulation testing, and chemically informed tasting workflows
using the built-in *Swertia chirayita* datasets.

## Vocabulary harmonization & panelist scaling

`harmonize_terms()` orders dictionary patterns by decreasing length and applies
two-pass sentinel token replacement (`\x01<idx>\x02`) so shorter patterns never
overwrite substrings inside already-translated terms:

```{r}
#| label: harmonize-terms

data(dictionary_generic)
harmonize_terms(
  dictionary = dictionary_generic,
  x = c("amer", "acidulé", "métallique"),
  mode = "word"
)
```

`load_consistent_profiles()` retains taste descriptors used by at least
`min_jury` distinct panelists and optionally applies multiplicative
root-mean-square (RMS) scaling per juror (`normalize_panelists = TRUE`):

```{r}
#| label: consistent-profiles

data(profiles)
consistent_raw <- load_consistent_profiles(
  profiles,
  min_jury = 2L,
  normalize_panelists = FALSE
)
consistent_rms <- load_consistent_profiles(
  profiles,
  min_jury = 2L,
  normalize_panelists = TRUE
)
head(unique(consistent_rms[, c("taste", "sum_taste", "group")]), 10)
```

## 3-AFC concentration-response & psychometric threshold

`plot_concentration()` fits a guessing-corrected 3-AFC binomial psychometric
curve ($P(c) = 1/3 + (2/3)\Lambda(\beta(\log_{10} c - \mu))$) with 95%
delta-method confidence ribbons and marks the 50% true detection threshold
($\text{EC}_{50}$ at $P = 2/3$):

```{r}
#| label: plot-concentration
#| message: false
#| warning: false

out_conc <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
plot_concentration(output = out_conc, afc_m = 3L)
```

## Chasselas taste modulation (Pratt signed-rank test)

`plot_chasselas_modulation()` evaluates paired before/after wine taste ratings
around median zero using Pratt's (1959) zero-preserving Wilcoxon signed-rank
test (`test_method = "pratt"`), retaining zero differences during ranking with
exact zero- and tie-variance corrections:

```{r}
#| label: plot-modulation
#| message: false
#| warning: false

out_mod <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
plot_chasselas_modulation(output = out_mod, test_method = "pratt")
```

## Classical vs. chemically informed tasting

`plot_informed_tasting()` compares classical tasting of the raw extract against
gravimetrically weighted fraction tasting across all 14 consistent harmonized
descriptors:

```{r}
#| label: plot-informed
#| message: false
#| warning: false

out_inf <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
plot_informed_tasting(output = out_inf, normalize_panelists = TRUE)
```

## Sensory descriptors network

`plot_descriptors_network()` collapses parallel edges into edge weights
(`weight`) before computing the layout while scaling node sizes by total vertex
in-strength:

```{r}
#| label: plot-network
#| message: false
#| warning: false

out_net <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
plot_descriptors_network(output = out_net)
```
